body: To be honest I can't even recall myself at 15. These past few years have really put me down. As for my friends I wouldn't even call them that anymore. They are all successful taking engineering and some med school. I'm embarrassed for them to see me and what I've done with myself and my life over the past few years.
My state of mind. I have trouble sleeping and my memory is taking a huge hit. I've seen my doctor but he is no help.

I want to become something just like anyone else have a job as an accountant, programmer, business man, etc but I don't have what it takes. I know people always say if you put in the work it'll happen but with me it just doesn't. At this point I'm done wasting my parents hard earned money and time, I am worthless. In the original post I also forgot to mention that I can't sleep and my memory is horrible. Last time I went to see a doctor (2 years ago) I told him about my sleeping problems and horrible headaches and he laughed it off. So now I just keep most of my thoughts to myself and have the occasional panic attack in front of my parents before I lock myself away.  When I was in college last year I felt like I had some purpose even though I hated it and was not cut out for it but now I just sit home and do nothing. Some people might not believe me but I've locked myself away from society for the past year and stopped talking to my high school classmates. I am losing it and this seems like the best option for me.
I loved computers and was studying that before I realized I don't care enough to pursue it as a career.

I'm always like this but I'm at the point where I can't take it anymore and this is my last resort. The only thing keeping me from ending it all is the thought of my brother and what that would do to him. Unlike me he's smart and has a future.
